svg.text: EPLZON 1.5 x 2 in solderable breadboard, top view. Each row is two copper strips on the back: A-E and F-J.
holds GPIO6 low while the ESP is off
holds GPIO10 low while the ESP is off
U1 ESP32-C3 columns C and G, rows 1-8, USB-C off the top
U2 74AHCT125 columns E and F, rows 10-16, notch at row 10
Dry-fit the C3 and the chip: both straddle the center gap.
Column G must read 5V, G, 3.3, 4 from the USB-C end.
Long jumpers run on the back, insulated.
Meter before plugging in: no 5V-GND short, chip pin 14 = 5V.
